<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Pagină-1" id="vWR3Y8U4rHYtrny4ng1T"> <mxGraphModel dx="2876" dy="1152" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml UC4_Care
 left to right direction
 skinparam packageStyle rectangle
 skinparam actorStyle awesome

 actor Owner
 actor \"Scheduler\n(daily job)\" as Scheduler <<system>>
 actor \"Weather API\" as Weather <<external>>

 rectangle \"DogApp – 4. Care\" {
 ' --- Breed info ---
 usecase \"View breed info\" as UC_BreedInfo
 usecase \"View care tips\nfor my dog\" as UC_CareTips
 usecase \"Show medical\ndisclaimer\" as UC_Disclaimer

 ' --- Health records ---
 usecase \"View health history\" as UC_History
 usecase \"Add health record\" as UC_AddRecord
 usecase \"Add vaccine /\ndeworming\" as UC_AddVaccine
 usecase \"Log vet visit\" as UC_AddVet
 usecase \"Log weight\" as UC_AddWeight
 usecase \"Set next due date\" as UC_DueDate
 usecase \"Edit / delete record\" as UC_EditRecord
 usecase \"View weight chart\" as UC_WeightChart

 ' --- Reminders & tips ---
 usecase \"Check upcoming\ndue dates\" as UC_CheckDue
 usecase \"Send reminder\" as UC_SendReminder
 usecase \"View daily tip\" as UC_DailyTip
 usecase \"Get local weather\" as UC_GetWeather
 usecase \"Find nearby vet\n(→ 5. Map)\" as UC_FindVet
 }

 Owner --> UC_BreedInfo
 Owner --> UC_CareTips
 Owner --> UC_History
 Owner --> UC_AddRecord
 Owner --> UC_DailyTip

 UC_CareTips ..> UC_Disclaimer : <<include>>
 UC_DailyTip ..> UC_Disclaimer : <<include>>

 UC_AddVaccine ..> UC_AddRecord : <<extend>>
 UC_AddVet ..> UC_AddRecord : <<extend>>
 UC_AddWeight ..> UC_AddRecord : <<extend>>
 UC_AddVaccine ..> UC_DueDate : <<include>>
 UC_EditRecord ..> UC_History : <<extend>>
 UC_WeightChart ..> UC_History : <<extend>>
 UC_FindVet ..> UC_History : <<extend>>

 Scheduler --> UC_CheckDue
 UC_CheckDue ..> UC_SendReminder : <<include>>

 UC_DailyTip ..> UC_GetWeather : <<include>>
 UC_GetWeather --> Weather

 note right of UC_CareTips
 Personalized from Breed:
 size, energyLevel,
 heatSensitive, breathingIssues
 + dog's age and weight.
 end note

 note right of UC_DailyTip
 Example: heatSensitive breed
 and > 28°C → \"walk early
 morning, avoid asphalt\".
 Weather uses approx location.
 end note

 note bottom of UC_CheckDue
 Runs daily. Finds HealthRecords
 with nextDueDate in 7 days / 1 day
 → email / in-app reminder.
 end note
 @enduml
",
 "config": null
